title: The BEST Meta Ads Strategy for 2026
description: The BEST Meta Ads Strategy for 2026
transcript: Running meta ad campaigns is nothing like what it used to be. Here's the best strategy for most businesses in 2026. Instead of having a really complicated sales funnel with lots of different campaigns, I'd recommend that most businesses have a scaling campaign and a testing campaign. We would both be targeting the same people, a mixture of cold and warm audiences, both direct to offer. So directly selling your products and services to your customers. You want to put the majority of your budget into your scaling campaign, but leave some budget for experimenting with creative different offers that can set you up for long term success.
